official_source_url.value: http://www.rree.gob.pe/ (Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores del Peru — the ministry that processes visa applications through Peruvian consulates)

cross_verification.note_en: Peru's Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores (RREE) processes visa applications via its consulates. Its official visa application form (DGC-005) and a consular 'VISAS' requirements PDF are hosted on consulado.pe, but every WebFetch attempt against that domain returned an SSL certificate-validation error, and the ministry's own gob.pe-platform pages return the same HTTP 418 anti-bot block documented for pe-passport.json. No composition field could be independently confirmed from a government source in this research pass. The rree.gob.pe root domain is listed as official_source_url only as the correct authority to consult, not as a page whose content was read.
